hskSource.wordPolicy: Exact headword; homograph markers removed; levels refer to first introduction of each listed sense, not later part-of-speech extensions.
hskSource.characterPolicy: Official recognition-character tables, not inferred from containing words. HSK7-9 is one combined official table.

dictionarySource.changes: Canonical simplified Han-only headwords; exact whole-entry aliases and reading-aware ambiguous aliases derived from pinned CC-CEDICT. Raw source and factual modern IDS remain unchanged. No curriculum identities added.

meta.policy: Browsing only. HSK membership is official; dictionary readings/English senses are not sense-to-level aligned. 7-9 is a combined band. Modern IDS links are dataset-derived, not reviewed semantic/phonetic claims.
